dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea - Earthquake on Jun 19 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000ql8u](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000ql8u) Magnitude 5.6 earthquake at 61.515 depth occurred on Jun 19 2025 30km E of Turuo. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -6.2862 longitude 147.8581. It impacted 33271 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
